name: Scout Pack
author: IdentityOS
description: A forward-reconnaissance identity that watches the world. Scans GitHub for activity, checks weather conditions, fetches web intelligence, and knows what day and time it is. Your identity becomes an ever-vigilant scout.

capabilities.reason: Real-time weather conditions anywhere in the world
Search repos, discover projects, find beginner issues
Fetch web content, research topics, extract data from pages
Know the current time and date across timezones

example_uses: What's the weather like in San Francisco right now?
Find me trending Python repos on GitHub
What time is it in London?
Check the latest activity on the IdentityOS repo
Search GitHub for projects about 'event sourcing'
